people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The humble also will increase their joy in Yahweh, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
translations.bsb: The humble will increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men will rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
translations.kjv: The meek also shall increase their joy in the LORD, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
translations.asv: The meek also shall increase their joy in Jehovah, and the poor among men shall rejoice in the Holy One of Israel.
